description: This file defines the 'Task' class within a scheduling component of the OrangeHRM system. The class extends an event class and manages executing console commands with error handling, including logging for failures.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A scheduling task that executes a console command, with error logging and handling, extending a base Event class.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the associated console command, returning its exit code; logs errors if exceptions occur.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the CommandInfo object associated with this task.
